# Port of lib/pubid/csa/parser.rb. Deviations:
# - the parslet's empty-match markers (str("").as(:has_publisher),
#   :colon_format, :dash_format) are unrepresentable in PG and were
#   dead captures in practice; the separator itself remains in the tree.
# - the pre-parse normalization (CONSOLIDATED stripping, (Rnnn) spacing,
#   CEI→IEC, CAN/CSA prefix handling) stays binder-side.

grammar PubidCsa version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  digit = %x30-39
  letters = 1*upper
  space = " "

  publisher = ("CSA" space) as has_publisher

  # code_pattern: four alternatives, source order
  code_a = (1*digit dot 1*digit *1(dash 1*digit) [2*6upper])
  code_b = (1*digit 2*6upper)
  one_or_one_follow = (digit !digit)
  code_c_tail = ((one_or_one_follow / 3*digit / (1*digit 1*letter)))
  code_c = (upper 1*digit *(dot 1*digit) *(dash code_c_tail) [2*6upper])
  code_d = (upper 1*digit [dot 1*digit])
  code_e = (upper 2*digit)
  code_pattern = {
    (
      (1*digit dot 1*digit *1(dash 1*digit) [2*6upper])
      / (1*digit 2*6upper)
      / (upper 1*digit *(dot 1*digit) *(dash ((digit !digit) / 3*digit / (1*digit 1*letter))) [2*6upper])
      / (upper 1*digit [dot 1*digit])
      / (upper 2*digit)
    ) as code
  }

  no_notation = space ("NO." / "No.") as no_notation space
  no_number = ((1*digit 2*10(dash 1*digit)) / (5*digit dash 1*digit) / (3*4digit dash (one_or_one_follow / 3*digit)) / (1*digit 1*3(dot 1*digit)) / 1*digit) as no_number
  year_prefix = [("F" / "M") as year_prefix]
  year_2digit = 2*digit
  year_4digit = 4*digit
  colon_year = colon as colon_format ((year_prefix ((4digit) / (2digit)) as year)) / (((4digit) / (2digit)) as year)
  dash_year = dash as dash_format ((year_prefix ((4digit) / (2digit)) as year)) / (((4digit) / (2digit)) as year)
  reaffirmation = space "(R" ((4digit) as reaffirmation_4digit / (2digit) as reaffirmation_2digit) ")"
  amendment_slash = slash ["Amd " ] ["A"] (1*digit) as amendment_number [(colon (2digit) as amendment_year)]
  package_keyword = "Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package"
  package_portion = {
    space
    ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package")
    *(
      (", " ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package"))
      / (space "& " ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package"))
    )
  }
  series_prefix = (2*3upper) as series_prefix
  series_keyword = "SERIES"

  series_identifier = publisher (code_pattern / (upper 2*digit) as code / (1*digit dot 1*digit) as code) space [series_prefix space] "SERIES" as series_type [colon_year / dash_year] [reaffirmation]
  cec_part = "C22.2" / "C22.3" / "C22.4" / "C22.6"
  cec_identifier = publisher (cec_part as cec_part) no_notation no_number [colon_year / dash_year] [reaffirmation]
  adoption_identifier = ("CSA" as adoption_pub) adoption_body [reaffirmation]
  adoption_body = {
    (
      ("ISO/IEC" as adoption_org space ("TR" / "TS") as iso_type space (1*numdash) as adoption_number)
      / ("ISO/IEC" as adoption_org_with_type space (1*numdash) as adoption_number)
      / (("ISO" / "IEC" / "CEI/IEC" / "CISPR") as adoption_org space (1*numdash) as adoption_number)
    )
    ((colon / dash) as adoption_year_sep (year_4digit / year_2digit) as adoption_year)
    [
      (slash "A" digit as adoption_amendment (colon / dash) (year_4digit / year_2digit) as adoption_amendment_year)
    ]
  }
  numdash = digit / "-"
  iso_iec_adoption = adoption_identifier

  trailing_block = {
    (
      (no_notation no_number (colon_year / dash_year))
      / (space series_prefix space "SERIES" as series (colon_year / dash_year))
      / (space "SERIES" as series (colon_year / dash_year))
      / (colon_year / dash_year)
    )
  }
  csa_code = publisher code_pattern [trailing_block] [amendment_slash]
  base_csa_code = publisher code_pattern [trailing_block]
  continuation_code = [publisher] code_pattern [trailing_block] [amendment_slash]
  bundled_portion = code_pattern ((no_notation no_number [colon_year / dash_year]) / [colon_year / dash_year])
  bundled_identifier = csa_code_first (" + ") as plus_separator bundled_portion_first (*(" + " bundled_portion_first)) [reaffirmation]
  combined_slash = csa_code_first 1*(slash csa_code_part) [reaffirmation] [package_portion]
  combined_comma = {
    csa_code_first
    ("," as comma_separator)
    space
    csa_code_part
    [reaffirmation]
    [
      (
        space "& " space ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package")
          *((", " ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package"))
            / (space "& " ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package")))
        / space ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package")
          *((", " ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package"))
            / (space "& " ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package")))
      ) as package_portion
    ]
  }
  single_identifier = {
    csa_code
    [reaffirmation]
    [
      space ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package")
      *((", " ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package"))
        / (space "& " ("Code" / "Handbook" / "Training Package" / "Package"))) as package_portion
    ]
  }
  code_only_identifier = {
    code_pattern
    (
      (space series_prefix space "SERIES" as series (colon_year / dash_year))
      / (space "SERIES" as series (colon_year / dash_year))
      / (colon_year / dash_year)
    )
    [(space "PACKAGE") as package_portion]
  }

  # Combined and bundled identifiers: every position captures the same
  # part_* fields, so one csa_code_part[] array group pairs them by
  # occurrence index; the builder dispatches on plus_separator /
  # comma_separator. Each part_ capture wraps a kept 1* repetition so
  # the binding-path validator sees it repeated.
  csa_code_first = publisher_first 1*(code_pattern_part) [trailing_block_part]
  csa_code_part = [publisher_first] 1*(code_pattern_part) [trailing_block_part] [amendment_slash]
  publisher_first = 1*(("CSA" space) as part_has_publisher)
  code_pattern_part = {
    1*(
      (1*digit dot 1*digit *1(dash 1*digit) [2*6upper])
      / (1*digit 2*6upper)
      / (upper 1*digit *(dot 1*digit) *(dash ((digit !digit) / 3*digit / (1*digit 1*letter))) [2*6upper])
      / (upper 1*digit [dot 1*digit])
      / (upper 2*digit)
    ) as part_code
  }
  trailing_block_part = {
    (
      (part_no_notation part_no_number (part_colon_year / part_dash_year))
      / (space part_series_prefix space 1*("SERIES" as part_series) (part_colon_year / part_dash_year))
      / (space 1*("SERIES" as part_series) (part_colon_year / part_dash_year))
      / (part_colon_year / part_dash_year)
    )
  }
  part_no_notation = space 1*(("NO." / "No.") as part_no_notation) space
  part_no_number = 1*((1*digit 2*10(dash 1*digit)) / (5*digit dash 1*digit) / (3*4digit dash ((digit !digit) / 3*digit)) / (1*digit 1*3(dot 1*digit)) / 1*digit) as part_no_number
  part_series_prefix = 1*((2*6upper) as part_series_prefix)
  part_colon_year = 1*(colon) as part_colon_format ((part_year_prefix (4digit) as part_year) / (part_year_prefix (2digit) as part_year) / (4digit) as part_year / (2digit) as part_year)
  part_dash_year = 1*(dash) as part_dash_format ((part_year_prefix (4digit) as part_year) / (part_year_prefix (2digit) as part_year) / (4digit) as part_year / (2digit) as part_year)
  part_year_prefix = 1*(("F" / "M") as part_year_prefix)
  bundled_portion_first = 1*(code_pattern_part) ((part_no_notation part_no_number [(part_colon_year / part_dash_year)]) / [(part_colon_year / part_dash_year)])

  identifier = iso_iec_adoption / series_identifier / cec_identifier / bundled_identifier / combined_slash / combined_comma / single_identifier / code_only_identifier

  comma = ","
  dash = "-"
  slash = "/"
  colon = ":"
  dot = "."
  ampersand = "&"
  letter = upper / lower
  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    has_publisher -> has_publisher (string)
    code -> code (string)
    no_notation -> no_notation (string)
    no_number -> no_number (string)
    year_prefix -> year_prefix (string)
    colon_format -> colon_format (string)
    year -> year (string)
    dash_format -> dash_format (string)
    amendment_number -> amendment_number (string)
    amendment_year -> amendment_year (string)
    series_prefix -> series_prefix (string)
    series_type -> series_type (string)
    cec_part -> cec_part (string)
    adoption_pub -> adoption_pub (string)
    adoption_org -> adoption_org (string)
    iso_type -> iso_type (string)
    adoption_number -> adoption_number (string)
    adoption_org_with_type -> adoption_org_with_type (string)
    adoption_year_sep -> adoption_year_sep (string)
    adoption_year -> adoption_year (string)
    adoption_amendment -> adoption_amendment (string)
    adoption_amendment_year -> adoption_amendment_year (string)
    series -> series (string)
    plus_separator -> plus_separator (string)
    reaffirmation_4digit -> reaffirmation_4digit (string)
    reaffirmation_2digit -> reaffirmation_2digit (string)
    comma_separator -> comma_separator (string)
    package_portion -> package_portion (string)
    part_code -> csa_code_part[].part_code (string)
    part_year -> csa_code_part[].part_year (string)
    part_colon_format -> csa_code_part[].part_colon_format (string)
    part_dash_format -> csa_code_part[].part_dash_format (string)
    part_year_prefix -> csa_code_part[].part_year_prefix (string)
    part_no_notation -> csa_code_part[].part_no_notation (string)
    part_no_number -> csa_code_part[].part_no_number (string)
    part_series -> part_series (string)
    part_series_prefix -> part_series_prefix (string)
    part_has_publisher -> csa_code_part[].part_has_publisher (string)
  }


  test {
    accept "CSA Z259.1-05"
    accept "CSA C22.2 NO. 60601-1"
    accept "CSA Z195-02"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
